articles.title: Iran says it is 'fully prepared' to counter widened US economic sanctions
articles.description: The US calls its latest sanctions on Iran an "economic D-Day", but Tehran says it has a plan to counter them.

articles.title: UK drone factories may face attacks from 'unknown sources', says Kremlin adviser
articles.description: The comments on BBC Newsnight come after the UK announced it has agreed to hand over blueprints for British-made missile components to Ukraine.

articles.title: US-Canada trade war escalates as Trump threatens tariff hike on vehicles
articles.description: Mark Carney accused Trump of wanting to "destroy" Canada's auto industry, and said he would only resume trade talks if the US comes with the "right attitude".

articles.title: Israel warns of 'forceful' response to kites flown from Gaza
articles.description: Hamas says the kites found in Israeli border communities in recent days were launched by children in Gaza.

articles.title: Russia's second-biggest online retailer targeted in Ukrainian strikes
articles.description: Ozon says its warehouses across southern Russia, including in Dagestan and Krasnodar, were hit in the overnight strikes.

articles.title: Access to Zambian courts prevented as election petition deadline looms
articles.description: Preparations for President Hakainde Hichilema's second inauguration appear to be continuing.

articles.title: Canadian politician threatens to cut off electricity to the US - as Trump issues 'fall in line' warning
articles.description: A Canadian politician has threatened to cut off electricity and mineral supplies to the US after President Trump raised tariffs on some goods to 50%.
